CREATE TABLE WEBHOOKKIND
   (	ID NUMBER(5,0), 
	NAME VARCHAR2(100), 
	DESCRIPTION VARCHAR2(1024),
	CONSTRAINT WEBHOOKKIND_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID)
   ) ;
   
CREATE TABLE WEBHOOK 
   (	ID NUMBER(9,0), 
	CALLBACK VARCHAR2(512), 
	TYPE NUMBER(5,0), 
	RESTENDPOINTID NUMBER(9,0), 
	RETRYCOUNT NUMBER(5,0) DEFAULT 3, 
	MAPPER VARCHAR2(2024), 
	ACTIVE NUMBER(1,0) DEFAULT 1, 
	TEMPLATE CLOB, 
	 CONSTRAINT WEBHOOK_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID)  USING INDEX  ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT FK_WEBHOOKKIND FOREIGN KEY (TYPE)	  REFERENCES WEBHOOKKIND (ID) ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT FK_RESTENDPOINTS FOREIGN KEY (RESTENDPOINTID)	  REFERENCES RESTENDPOINTS (ID) ENABLE
   ) ;
	 

CREATE TABLE WEBHOOKTRACK 
   (	ID NUMBER(5,0) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	SPECIFICATIONID NUMBER(5,0), 
	REQUESTID VARCHAR2(120), 
	SUCESSFULLY NUMBER(1,0), 
	RETRY NUMBER(1,0), 
	REASON VARCHAR2(512), 
	STACK CLOB, 
	CREATEDATE DATE, 
	ORIGEN CLOB, 
	RESPONSE CLOB, 
	REQUEST CLOB, 
	UPDATEDATE DATE, 
	TYPEID NUMBER(5,0), 
	 CONSTRAINT WEBHOOKTRACK_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID)  USING INDEX  ENABLE
   ) ;
